From the sea

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

A fish tavern by the Mackenzie harbour

Zephyros Beach Tavern stands on Piale Pasa 37 at Mackenzie in Larnaca: a large dining room with blue tablecloths and a terrace looking over the water. Google lists it as a fish restaurant, in Greek as Ψαροταβέρνα Ζέφυρος. Guests on Google mention the fish meze most of all, then the Greek salad, the calamari, the grilled octopus and the sea view.

Open every day from half past eleven in the morning until half past ten at night. Takeaway and delivery as well.

What guests say

Two of 3,330 Google reviews, 4.3 stars on average.

“Had an amazing time here! The food was delicious, the service was friendly and attentive, and the view was absolutely stunning. Perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great meal. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience with a beautiful atmosphere!”
Karol Nedza · Google review
“Looking out over the Marina ... We love visiting. Beautiful lunch for Christmas Eve with my husband. Our favourite fish taverna. I had the best fish and my husband highly recommends the mixed grill. This is one of our favourite restaurants in Larnaca ... Looking out onto the Bay and enjoying the view. Ideal for family gatherings.”
Elize Venter · Google review
